notes.title: 2020 Update Part 1 Oculus Rift S Support
notes.content:
Hello there cricketers!

It has been a while and we would like to thank you for your continued support over these past few years. 

Today we are rolling out support for the Oculus Rift S along with a few more neat changes to the in game keyboards, wagon wheels, scorecards, a speed challenge mode and a bunch of smaller bug fixes.

We have also added a shortcut to change your position and rotation settings on the pitch, you can access this by pressing CTRL + M, press it once for right handed settings, twice for left handed and three times to toggle it off again. This function will be more accessible via in game settings in the next update.

We will be posting a thread on the discussions page shortly where we will list some of our ideas for the next content update and we would love to see your ideas and suggestions.

Enjoy!

notes.title: The January 2018 Update Is Here
notes.content:
Dear Balls! Fans,

**** JANUARY 2018 - UPDATE IS HERE ***

Thank you for your ongoing support and for posting feedback.

After gathering extensive feedback over the past few months, and after many requests from you all, we're thrilled to announce our new update to Balls! We're sure you'll agree that the changes and enhancements have improved the game, especially now that the crashing issue has been resolved. 

We're still open to more feedback and will continue to refine the game as we get that feedback.

Please continue to post your comments on the community boards and we'll ensure our developers get the feedback.

We hope you enjoy the game with all the new features and improvements.

Thanks for your support!

The stickee team

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Hi guys, 

we've taken your feedback onboard and added a few of the suggestions we considered a top priority. These include:

- the scoring for 1s, 2s and 3s
- increased pitch size for the international setting
- improved bat and ball collision physics

We are looking forward to hearing some feedback regarding the new physics tweaks. Please don't hesitate to message us!

We're currently working on more of the suggested features and there will be another update in November. Thank you for your continued support and feedback and we will continue working to make this game the best it can be! :)
